text.autoconfig.hudrendererlib.option.ad: Adjust Top Right Elements With Status Effects

Shifts elements with the "Top Right" alignment down by the specified amount of pixels below if potion effects are being overlayed in the top right. Only applies while Show Vanilla Status Effects is on.
